scientific_integrity: Analytical character-orthogonality and full block decomposition proof; finite numerical and integer tests are supplementary, not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: First spatial Hamming ball and first character band only; q>=3,d>=3; finite abelian alphabets; not higher Hamming radii. An implicit older association-scheme presentation remains a priority risk.
title: Exact four-level Fourier concentration on nonbinary Hamming one-balls
